reports.title: GCC Statistical Centre (GCC-Stat)
reports.publisher: Statistical Centre for the Cooperation Council for the Arab Countries of the Gulf
reports.description: Regional statistical body serving the six GCC member states (Bahrain, Kuwait, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, UAE); established June 2011, with its Charter formally endorsed by the GCC Supreme Council in December 2012. Coordinates harmonisation of national statistics and produces regional indicators.

reports.title: System of National Accounts 1993 (1993 SNA)
reports.publisher: United Nations Statistical Commission / UN Statistics Division
reports.description: The 1993 edition of the System of National Accounts, adopted by the UN Statistical Commission at its 27th session as the international standard for compiling national accounts. Predecessor to SNA 2008; still the framework explicitly named by some national statistical offices' methodology pages.

reports.title: Department of Statistics (DoS)
reports.publisher: Department of Statistics, Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan
reports.description: Jordan's national statistics office, established in late 1949 and operating under Statistics Law No. 24 of 1950; compiles and disseminates national accounts, price indices, population and labour statistics.

reports.title: Jordan National Accounts (Annual and Quarterly GDP)
reports.publisher: Department of Statistics (DoS)
reports.description: Annual and quarterly Jordanian GDP and national accounts estimates by production, expenditure and income approaches, compiled by the Department of Statistics.

reports.title: Jordan Consumer Price Index (CPI)
reports.publisher: Department of Statistics (DoS)
reports.description: Monthly Jordanian Consumer Price Index tracking household goods-and-services prices, compiled by the Department of Statistics and disseminated on a fixed SDDS timetable.

reports.title: Central Administration of Statistics (CAS)
reports.publisher: Central Administration of Statistics, Presidency of the Council of Ministers, Lebanese Republic
reports.description: Lebanon's national statistics office, producing national accounts, CPI, and survey/census data; continues to operate and publish current data despite the country's severe post-2019 economic and institutional strain.

reports.title: Lebanon National Accounts Estimates
reports.publisher: Central Administration of Statistics (CAS)
reports.description: Annual Lebanese GDP and national accounts estimates compiled by CAS; the current estimates (through 2024, with revisions) state they are prepared according to SNA 2008 standards.

reports.title: Lebanon Consumer Price Index (CPI)
reports.publisher: Central Administration of Statistics (CAS)
reports.description: Monthly Lebanese Consumer Price Index measuring household price inflation, compiled by CAS and continuing to be published on schedule through the post-2019 crisis period.

reports.title: Central Statistical Bureau (CSB)
reports.publisher: Central Statistical Bureau, State of Kuwait
reports.description: Kuwait's national statistics office, responsible for national accounts, CPI, trade statistics, censuses and statistical yearbooks; operates a National Summary Data Page in cooperation with the Central Bank of Kuwait under the IMF's enhanced GDDS.

reports.title: Kuwait Gross Domestic Product Estimates
reports.publisher: Central Statistical Bureau (CSB)
reports.description: Annual and quarterly Kuwaiti GDP estimates at current and constant prices, compiled by the Central Statistical Bureau under the 1993 System of National Accounts framework.

reports.title: Kuwait Consumer Price Index
reports.publisher: Central Statistical Bureau (CSB)
reports.description: Monthly Kuwaiti Consumer Price Index covering roughly 1,100 items across eight expenditure categories, compiled by the Central Statistical Bureau with weights from the 1999/2000 Household Expenditure Survey.

reports.title: Balance of Payments Statistics of Kuwait
reports.publisher: Central Bank of Kuwait
reports.description: Kuwait's balance of payments and related external-sector statistics, compiled and disseminated by the Central Bank of Kuwait using data from the Central Statistical Bureau, Ministry of Oil and other agencies.

reports.title: National Statistics Center (National Planning Council)
reports.publisher: National Planning Council, State of Qatar
reports.description: Qatar's national statistics authority. Established as the National Statistics Center within the General Secretariat of the National Planning Council under Amiri Decision No. 13 of 2024, which replaced the former Planning and Statistics Authority (PSA); named the official source of the State's official statistics.

reports.title: Qatar Consumer Price Index (CPI)
reports.publisher: National Planning Council
reports.description: Monthly Qatari Consumer Price Index tracking household price inflation, currently released by the National Planning Council following the 2024 restructuring of Qatar's statistics authority.

reports.title: National Centre for Statistics and Information (NCSI)
reports.publisher: National Centre for Statistics and Information, Sultanate of Oman
reports.description: Oman's national statistics office, responsible for national accounts, CPI, population and other official statistics, and host of the country's e-GDDS National Summary Data Page.

reports.title: Oman National Accounts (GDP and related)
reports.publisher: National Centre for Statistics and Information (NCSI)
reports.description: Omani national accounts and GDP series compiled by NCSI; applies the 2008 System of National Accounts, with 2018 as the current base year (replacing 2010).

reports.title: Oman Consumer Price Index (CPI)
reports.publisher: National Centre for Statistics and Information (NCSI)
reports.description: Monthly Omani Consumer Price Index covering 392 items across 12 expenditure categories, compiled by NCSI with 2012 as base year and weights from the 2008/09-2010/11 Household Expenditure and Income Surveys.

reports.title: Information & eGovernment Authority (iGA) — Statistics & Population
reports.publisher: Information & eGovernment Authority, Kingdom of Bahrain
reports.description: Bahrain's national statistics body; "Statistics & Population" is one of iGA's three core business lines. Compiles national accounts, CPI and other macroeconomic statistics and hosts Bahrain's e-GDDS National Summary Data Page, launched in 2024.

reports.title: Bahrain National Accounts / GDP
reports.publisher: Information & eGovernment Authority (iGA)
reports.description: Bahraini GDP and national accounts estimates compiled by iGA; adopts the 1993 System of National Accounts while incorporating selected 2008 SNA treatments (fixed-asset classification, FISIM, R&D), with work under way toward full 2008 SNA implementation.

reports.title: Bahrain Consumer Price Index (CPI)
reports.publisher: Information & eGovernment Authority (iGA)
reports.description: Monthly Bahraini Consumer Price Index of 578 elementary aggregates classified under COICOP 1999, compiled by iGA using weights from the 2014/15 Household Income and Expenditure Survey.

_dropped.edge: qa-psa (node, and its 2 edges qa-psa -> imf-e-gdds, qa-psa -> gcc-stat)
_dropped.why: [CONFLICT, RESOLVED] me-gulf-levant-research-batch1.json proposed Qatar's stats authority as 'qa-psa' (Planning and Statistics Authority) while gulf-levant-research-batch1.json proposed 'qa-nsc' (National Statistics Center under the new National Planning Council) for the same institutional role. Verified live via gco.gov.qa and npc.qa: Amiri Decision No. 13 of 2024 explicitly 'replace[d] the Planning and Statistics Authority' with the National Planning Council, whose National Statistics Center is now 'the official source of official statistics for the State.' Only qa-nsc holds up as the current node; qa-psa and its two proposed edges (both otherwise well-evidenced for the underlying facts of Qatar's e-GDDS participation and GCC membership) are dropped as attributed to a defunct institution — those facts are captured instead via qa-nsc's edges.

[DUPLICATE CLAIM, BOTH FAIL EDITION TEST] gulf-levant proposed this from jo-cpi (dosweb price-indices page), me-gulf-levant proposed it from jo-national-accounts (DSBB NAG00 page). Both pages independently fetched: DOS's price-indices page says only 'The international Classification of Individual Consumption according to Purpose (COICOP) is used in addition to other international methodologies' and the DSBB NAG00 methodology summary likewise says only 'The Classification of individual consumption by purpose (COICOP) is used' -- neither names an edition/year. Per the edition-matching rule, a generic COICOP mention with no year is not enough to pick un-coicop-hbs-1999 vs un-coicop-2018, so neither edge is minted regardless of which source-node is used.

me-gulf-levant proposed this at the jo-national-accounts (report) level, citing the AR2024 Annual Observance Report which is actually a country-wide SDDS compliance document, not specific to the national-accounts release. Re-attributed the same verified evidence to the institutional node (jo-dos -> imf-sdds, minted above) as the more accurate match, and separately kept jo-cpi -> imf-sdds where DOS's own CPI page makes a report-specific SDDS claim. This entry is dropped as redundant with jo-dos -> imf-sdds, not as unverifiable.

gulf-levant-research-batch2.json proposed this as 'uses_data_from', quoting DOS's role as customs-data source for Jordan's balance of payments. Verified via DSBB (BOP00 category) that Jordan's BOP does follow BPM6 and that DOS-supplied customs data does feed it -- but the compiling body is the Central Bank of Jordan, and the real relationship is two edges neither of which matches what was proposed: a not-yet-proposed 'jo-bop' report would need methodology_depends_on -> imf-bpm6, and uses_data_from -> jo-dos (reversed direction from what was submitted, and wrong target -- a standard, not a data source). No jo-bop node exists in this batch to be a correct endpoint, so this is a real lead, not a mintable edge as stated.

me-gulf-levant-research-batch1.json's evidence_url (dsbb.imf.org/e-gdds/country/LBN/summary-of-dissemination) is a JS shell with no country-specific content when fetched live. The DSBB JSON API pattern returned genuinely stale content -- Lebanon's DSBB national-accounts metadata literally says 'National accounts data have not been compiled on a regular basis. The last set of estimates was compiled for 1994/1995,' clearly outdated relative to CAS's current live releases. Searched for an IMF NSDP-implementation press release for Lebanon (found similar releases for Bahrain, Oman, Kuwait, UAE, Mauritania, Vietnam, Djibouti, Jamaica -- but none for Lebanon). Could not independently confirm Lebanon's e-GDDS participation on any live primary source despite reasonable effort; consistent with the expected 'Lebanon comes back thin' outcome.

me-gulf-levant-research-batch2.json's cited quote -- 'The CPI produced by CAS since December 2007 was a readily available source' -- does not discuss COICOP at all; it's about the CPI being a data source for a different national-accounts compilation task, not about the CPI's own classification standard. The quote is mismatched to the claim. Lebanon's DSBB CPI00 metadata was fetched directly: it is badly stale (1997 base year, coverage described as of 1999) and does not name any COICOP edition either. Dropped as unsupported.

Proposed identically in both gulf-levant-research-batch2.json and me-gulf-levant-research-batch2.json (exact duplicate claim), quoting Oman's DSBB CPI page: '392 items in the index are classified according to the international classification the Classification of Individual Consumption by Purpose (COICOP).' Re-fetched that page directly and confirmed no edition/year is named anywhere on it. Per the edition-matching rule this is too ambiguous to pick un-coicop-hbs-1999 over un-coicop-2018 -- dropped, not minted to either.

gulf-levant-research-batch2.json proposed a separate node 'Bahrain CPI Compilation Methodology (as documented in DSBB)' pointing at the same DSBB CPI00 metadata page already used to source bh-cpi's own methodology edges (bh-cpi -> sna-2008, bh-cpi -> cpi-manual, bh-cpi -> un-coicop-hbs-1999, all minted above). This isn't a distinct recurring publication or instrument -- it's the DSBB metadata about bh-cpi itself -- so it's dropped as a node; the underlying facts are already captured as edges on bh-cpi.
